question: Does causally observed early concentration among the top 20 non-curve token-account owners add signal-quality information beyond Participant Quality and existing flow evidence?

feature_contract.definition: At a read-only snapshot requested no earlier than T0+3s and completed by T0+5s, query standard Solana RPC getTokenSupply, getTokenLargestAccounts, and getMultipleAccounts(jsonParsed) for the returned token accounts; aggregate returned raw balances by parsed token-account owner, exclude the decoded Pump bonding_curve owner, divide each remaining aggregated balance by exact raw total supply, and sum squared shares.
feature_contract.coverage_scope: top 20 token accounts returned by getTokenLargestAccounts only; this is not full-holder HHI
feature_contract.denominator_policy: exact raw total supply from getTokenSupply; never rebase to tradeable float or remaining non-curve supply
feature_contract.owner_aggregation_policy: sum balances for duplicate owners among the returned top 20 token accounts before HHI; accounts outside the top 20 are intentionally unobserved
feature_contract.market_owner_exclusion_policy: exclude the decoded Pump bonding_curve owner; if a PumpSwap create-pool event for the same mint is causally observed before snapshot request, feature is MISSING

acquisition.source: standard Solana JSON-RPC only; Helius holder APIs are not used
acquisition.market_ingest: Solana public Standard WSS logsSubscribe + slotSubscribe; no HTTP hydration
acquisition.holder_rpc_endpoint_policy: select one non-Helius standard RPC endpoint before capture from configured SOLANA_RPC_URL/fallbacks, otherwise api.mainnet.solana.com; keep it fixed for the run
acquisition.late_or_rate_limited_or_incomplete_evide: MISSING; any HTTP/RPC 429 invalidates the acquisition at systems level

directional_read.next_step_if_sufficient: mechanism/robustness review then define/freeze a separate fresh-confirmation hypothesis
directional_read.next_step_if_insufficient: report insufficient sample; do not extend/repeat based on observed outcome
